bullets.title: WAOAW Sleep Mask
bullets.note: This has become my favorite sleep mask. The WAOAW is a contoured mask that removes all pressure from the eyes, and it’s been added to my list of “things I didn’t know I needed.” The design also blocks much more light than conventional masks. Special thanks to my girlfriend for the spot-on gift. Grumpy Tim is good for no one.

bullets.title: A South Texan’s Wild Quest to Break a National Birding Record
bullets.creator: Will McCarthy
bullets.note: ([@wrmccart](https://twitter.com/wrmccart)) for _Texas Monthly_. Subheadline: “When she began her year-long bird-spotting adventure, Tiffany Kersten was lost and lonely. She ended up achieving a major milestone—and finding her way.” I’ve been on a nature kick and wanted to keep feeding the furnace. This provided a nice boost, and I’m already brainstorming new adventures…

bullets.section: Shoes I’m enjoying for hiking several hours a day
bullets.title: Cloudventure
bullets.note: from [On](https://www.on-running.com/en-us) ([@on\_running](https://twitter.com/on_running)). I have [this pair](https://www.on-running.com/en-us/products/cloudventure/mens/black-reseda) in Black/Reseda. From On’s website: “The Cloudventure is a lightweight trail running shoe, built to excel in demanding outdoor conditions.” I’ve been pounding the hell out of these, and they’ve allowed me to hike more than I have in years without any pain from plantar fasciitis. I’ll be adding in [rucking](https://www.goruck.com/pages/what-is-rucking) soon then slowly progressing to trail running, which I loved when I was younger. Related reading: “[The Painless Path to Endurance](https://tim.blog/2011/12/06/the-painless-path-to-endurance-plus-breville-winner-and-more/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf).”
